title: A game with a lot of AI: LLM and Videos
author: Soulshellgames
selftext:
[My Summer Love](https://reddit.com/link/1qt7pcx/video/v7zorkb6lxgg1/player)



I developed my own game engine specifically for visual novels because I needed complete memory access control and multithreading capabilities to efficiently load and unload images and videos, as well as dynamically generate text with AI.

\- Local Large Language Model (LLM) for text generation using LlamaCpp, currently text generation is powered by Google Gemma 3.

\- Videos and images are generated with: Nano Banana Pro, Kling O1 and Kling 2.6. From videos, sprites are automatically extracted using computer vision algorithms: Thresholds, Smooth, and Sobel Filter.

Demo: [My Summer Love](https://soul-shell.itch.io/my-summer-love)

Please let me know what you think.

comments.author: GentlemanModan
comments.body:
I don't know how to tell this without getting a lot of dislikes so I will just go ahead. I have played it for a while, I didn't manage to play more but it's cringy, like a teenager who never had a relationship is trying to create a game about relationships. It's just weird and difficult for me to play it. 

Graphics are mid but acceptable if gameplay would be good.

replies.author: Soulshellgames
replies.body: No problem, I've had similar comments before, and it's a feeling it evokes in some players. Thanks for playing it!

replies.author: Retronitsu
replies.body: It's not "a feeling it evokes in some players" it's just straight up ass.

comments.author: AvailableProcess2059
comments.body: How do you find local language gen to be? I’m quite interested in adding this to a game I’m working on and the multi lingual is very important.

replies.author: Soulshellgames
replies.body: Gemma 3 is multilingual, although it's primarily geared towards English. My experience has been positive. I've mainly used it in Spanish, my native language, and it works well. Two French people have told me it's good. I've also tested it in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean, and it seems to work very well.

replies.author: AvailableProcess2059
replies.body: Awesome thanks for the response! Good luck on the game

comments.author: Brief-Number7936
comments.body:
So let me get this straight - The main appeal of visual novels is the well-defined characteristics and character themes you get to explore.

Which you're removing in favor of... unlimited dialogue?

replies.author: Soulshellgames
replies.body:
1. It's not true that the features you mentioned are being removed.

2. The value isn't in them being unlimited; the point is that the dialogues aren't static. The dialogues are spontaneous and tied to the game's context.

replies.author: Soulshellgames
replies.body:
There's no repository. 

I'd like to upload it in the future; right now it's a very raw engine and very tied to this video game. It needs polishing to make its functionality more general and easier to use.
